intro: On your turn (clockwise from Agekeeper), take any actions below in any order, as many times as you like.

children.label: Activate Crucible Card
children.body: Collect and discard the card set from your Codex; place Molten Coal in a Cauldron.

children.label: Build Astral House
children.body: Pay Planet-matching Common Cards; place 🏰 on a Zodiac Sign (Standard: 2 cards; Quickplay: 1).

children.label: Refine Reagent
children.body: Discard suited cards meeting the Cauldron RP Threshold; take 1 Reagent.

children.label: Trade
children.body: Exchange Common Cards, Reagents, or Active Crucible Cards.

gameModeNote.magnus: Misaligned players trade 2:1 in favor of the non-initiating player.

children.label: Duel
children.body: Wager a Spread card; roll dice — winner steals a card from rival's Spread.

children.label: Gambit
children.body: Summer only. Match rival's Active Crucible Alignment; roll to swap Crucible Cards.
